# @fyit/crouton-editor

> Rich text editor - TipTap-based with slash commands, variables, and live preview

AI hint: use when app has content/articles/posts/rich text

## Components

- `CroutonEditorBlocks`: Block-based editor with NodeView blocks and property panel slot
- `CroutonEditorPreview`: Live preview with variable interpolation
- `CroutonEditorSimple`: Full-featured TipTap editor wrapper with image upload and AI translation support
- `CroutonEditorVariables`: Variable insertion menu triggered by {{ — for email templates and dynamic content
- `CroutonEditorWithPreview`: Editor and preview side-by-side with responsive layout (tabs on mobile)

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useEditorVariables`
